DecisionEdits.description:
The `fields` a reviewer may correct, each optional but never null; `full_text` and
`editorial_summary` are not among them. Enum values mirror the schema enums of the app
(checked by its tests).
DecisionEdits.title: DecisionEdits

ErrorBody.description: `params` carries the values the translated message interpolates; no prose.
ErrorBody.title: ErrorBody

ErrorCode.description:
Every error the API returns, by a stable code; the UI translates it (docs/decisions.md,
2026-10-03). The values are the wire format: add, never rename.
ErrorCode.title: ErrorCode

RelatedArticle.description:
One entry of `related_articles`, as the parser writes it: `statute` is the law number
(None when the label could not be mapped), `articles` the article numbers as printed
("18", "17/3"), `raw` the line it came from ("" for an entry added by hand).
RelatedArticle.title: RelatedArticle

ReviewFilters.title: ReviewFilters

get.description:
The original PDF of a decision extraction, for the detail screen.

Copyright: the archive PDFs are pages of the journal Çalışma ve Toplum. They are served
only to a logged-in reviewer, for internal review, never publicly.

`ingest_file.path` is relative to `ARCHIVE_ROOT` (the loader stores the path under the Drive
copy, e.g. `Yargi_Kararlari_Arsivi/...`). The file is served only if it resolves inside the
root (no `..`, no symlink out), is within `ARCHIVE_MAX_FILE_BYTES` and its SHA-256 equals
`ingest_file.sha256`: no file rather than the wrong one. It is opened once, and the bytes
that were hashed are the bytes sent, so the file cannot change in between.
